visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair and white-rimmed glasses, wearing a light blue sweatshirt with a small cartoon character patch, holds a pink "Toy Story Alien" box. He gestures enthusiastically while speaking to the camera in a brightly lit indoor room. (2) The scene shifts to a close-up of a bronze-colored metallic figurine of the Alien character from Toy Story. It sits on a table surface decorated with green mahjong tiles. The lighting highlights the metallic sheen of the three-eyed alien figure. (3) The man is seen again, holding the bronze figurine. He moves it towards the camera to show its detail and then begins to shake it vigorously. Behind him, a row of green mahjong tiles is visible on the automatic mahjong table. (4) A close-up shows the bottom of the figurine as the man shakes it. A small metallic rod or slip, which acts as a fortune teller, slides out from the base. The background contains the mahjong table's green felt and tiles. (5) The man holds the extracted fortune slip, showing the Chinese characters "中吉" (Medium Luck) engraved on it. He points at the figurine excitedly. A logo for "Beast Kingdom" (野獸國) appears as an overlay in the final seconds of the video.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice speaks with high energy and a friendly tone. His speech is rapid and enthusiastic as he introduces a Toy Story product. Upbeat, moderate-tempo electronic background music plays throughout. (2) The vocal pauses momentarily, replaced by the distinct, sharp rattling sound of the figurine being shaken. The BGM maintains its steady beat in the background. (3) The speaker resumes talking with increased excitement, saying 'Wait, there it is!'. A subtle 'click' sound is heard as the fortune slip is pulled from the toy. (4) The speaker concludes by describing where to buy the item, his voice showing high arousal. The BGM remains constant until a final comedic SFX sound at the very end. The overall audio quality is clean and well-produced.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a lifestyle and hobby product review showcasing an Alien-themed fortune-telling figurine by Soap Studio. The creator uses the context of mahjong culture (shaking for luck) to demonstrate the product's interactive feature and encourages viewers to purchase it from Beast Kingdom.
